verdict.rationale: A public digital-services portal like impots.gouv.fr could plausibly publish developer APIs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an API reference, interactive documentation, or runnable examples. The items cover only user-facing services (login, payments, forms, simulators, and a 'Statistiques et Données' page), none of which is an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
